name: Concession cart (popcorn, cotton candy, snow cones)
colors: Red and white, or any color
placement: Near the kids' area or exit; allow an attendant and a queue space about 2 m in front; needs a power outlet for machines.
modeling: A base box 1.07 x 0.71 x 0.75 m on two large wheel cylinders 0.5 m across, a glass cabinet box on top to 1.2 m, a small roof box or a striped canopy tilted slab to 1.37 m, and a push handle bar at one end.
